description: This file defines a custom exception class ClientNonPersonNotFoundByClientIdException used in the Fineract project to indicate that a non-person client resource was not found by its client ID.

classes.name: ClientNonPersonNotFoundByClientIdException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception thrown when a non-person client resource identified by client ID is not found.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a specific message indicating the client ID that was not found.
